monica-parttime: Hi @tia-peopleops — quick question. I'm part-time and observe a religious holiday on Dec 25. Company shutdown is Dec 24-27 and there's a PTO blackout Dec 22-28. I usually work Saturdays; can I swap my Dec 23 shift for Dec 25 or get an accommodation? Trying to arrange travel.

tia-peopleops: Short answer: we try to be flexible. For part-time staff with religious observance during shutdown we offer two options: 1) a shift swap/shift-credit (manager-approved) that doesn't touch accrued PTO, or 2) a floating holiday if the shift swap isn't feasible. Need manager sign-off + local payroll check if payout.

monica-parttime: Great — what's the process?

tia-peopleops: Please follow these steps:
1) Manager and employee agree on the swap in writing (reply here or in portal).
2) Manager (cc @sam-mgr) submits People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> "Religious Observance Swap" with dates and desired option.
3) People Ops will confirm shift-credit vs floating holiday and update scheduling. Payroll only involved if there's a cash adjustment.

scheduling-bot: Reminder: shift swaps must be posted to the schedule 72 hours before the shift per scheduling policy.

sam-mgr: I can cover the staffing side. Monica, I approve swapping your Dec 23 shift to Dec 25 as long as you swap with a willing colleague or we can use the shift-credit bank. I'll submit in portal now.

monica-parttime: Thanks Sam — tagging Nicolas who usually swaps. Nicolas: can you cover Dec 23 -> Dec 25?

rahul-hr: Heads up on payroll: if the swap results in extra hours paid outside your normal schedule, we need to flag for overtime rules. For part-time hourly associates, shift-credit is preferred to avoid payroll adjustments.

tia-peopleops: Monica — once Sam submits I'll create ticket EX-2026-2003 and mark it as "religious swap approved". We'll annotate that this is a blackout exception and not charged to PTO.

monica-parttime: Perfect — Sam submitted and I see EX-2026-2003. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:

scheduling-bot: EX-2026-2003 updated: approved by sam-mgr at 1955002235

tia-peopleops: Done — marked as swap approved. Monica, I'll update your schedule and add a calendar note. If anyone else needs religious accommodation during shutdown, please batch requests to avoid multiple payroll/scheduling edits.
